fluff.overview: The Ocelot is a thirty-five-ton Clan light BattleMech designed by Clan Nova Cat following their Abjuration and relocation to the Irece Prefecture of the Draconis Combine. Produced at the Irece Alpha facility beginning in 3067, the design was developed by a team of Nova Cat researchers and captured Smoke Jaguar scientists under the direction of Khan Santin West. The Ocelot represented Clan Nova Cat's determination to rebuild their touman with domestically produced BattleMechs rather than relying solely on OmniMech production or outside procurement. At thirty-five tons, the design fills the role of a fast, aggressive skirmisher capable of punishing opponents at medium range while using its mobility to avoid sustained engagements.
fluff.capabilities:
The Ocelot's primary armament centers on a torso-mounted Model X heavy large laser, a weapon capable of devastating damage for a chassis of this weight class. The original design called for a shoulder mount similar to the Pack Hunter's weapon placement, but focusing difficulties with the heavy large laser forced the engineering team to relocate it to the main torso cavity with dedicated shock absorbers. This repositioning limits the weapon's firing arc, requiring pilots to twist the 'Mech's torso more aggressively than typical light designs, a tendency that becomes particularly pronounced during airborne evasive maneuvers when the design's center of gravity shifts toward the weapon.

Supporting the main gun, a pair of Series 2d extended-range medium lasers provide consistent mid-range firepower with an identical effective range envelope. A bank of fifteen double heat sinks manages the thermal load adequately under normal operations, though sustained fire combined with heavy jump jet use will eventually overwhelm the cooling system. To compensate for the chassis instability created by the heavy laser's mass, the designers implemented distinctive "stub wing" extensions that help maintain balance during the Ocelot's 180-meter jumps. An Irecian "Squealer" light active probe rounds out the sensor suite, ensuring pilots maintain situational awareness appropriate for the design's skirmisher role.
fluff.history:
The Ocelot emerged from one of the most turbulent periods in Clan Nova Cat's history. Following the Clan's Abjuration and expulsion from Clan space, the Nova Cats settled in the Irece Prefecture of the Draconis Combine, bringing with them a group of former Smoke Jaguar scientists acquired as isorla during their flight. Khan Santin West recognized that rebuilding the Clan's military capabilities required domestic manufacturing capacity, and in the early 3060s he directed these scientists alongside Nova Cat researchers to develop new BattleMech designs at the Irece Alpha facility, itself built on the ruins of the former LexaTech Industries plant destroyed during the initial Clan invasion.

The Ocelot entered production in 3067, just as the Word of Blake Jihad was beginning to engulf the Inner Sphere. Despite the chaos of the era, the design saw rapid deployment across Clan Nova Cat's frontline forces. The Jihad took a severe toll on Irece Alpha's workforce, with the facility losing fifty-five percent of its workers and operating at only sixty-five percent capacity by 3079. Still, production of the Ocelot and its variants continued throughout the conflict.

The design saw combat across multiple theaters during the Jihad, with Nova Cat forces deploying Ocelots in actions ranging from the failed 3072 attempt to liberate Luthien to various defensive engagements against Word of Blake forces. Individual Ocelots also found their way into Republic of the Sphere service during the early Dark Age, as some Nova Cat warriors brought their machines with them when joining the nascent state following the Jihad's conclusion.

The Irece Alpha facility suffered destruction during the Second Combine-Dominion War but was reconstructed during the 3120s, resuming production of the Ocelot and its variants. By the ilClan era, with Clan Nova Cat destroyed as a political entity, production continued under Draconis Combine authority, ensuring the design's continued availability to Combine forces.
fluff.deployment: Still undergoing trials as of 3075, this variant is a significant rethinking of the Ocelot's combat role. The armament is rebuilt around an extended-range large laser paired with two heavy medium lasers, supplemented by a targeting computer for enhanced accuracy and an ECM suite for electronic warfare protection. These changes come at the cost of three double heat sinks, making heat management a more pressing concern during prolonged engagements. Rather than manufacturing the targeting computer and ECM suite domestically, Clan Nova Cat negotiated with Clan Diamond Shark to supply both systems in exchange for a percentage of Irece Alpha's industrial output.
